programs.title: Doc Martin
programs.desc: With Louisa visiting her mother in Spain to get some perspective on their marriage, Martin knows he needs to try to change for the sake of their relationship, so he endeavours to keep his promise to her to see a therapist. Aunt Ruth arranges an appointment for him with Dr Rachel Timoney, but a lifeboat training exercise causes problems for the doctor. Will he get back in time for his first session? Martin Clunes stars.

programs.title: Bargain Hunt
programs.desc: Christina Trevanion is in Narberth, west Wales, where experts Philip Serrell and Kate Bliss help the teams find potentially profitable items to take to auction in Cardiff. Christina visits one of the oldest institutions in the world, the Royal Mint, to learn the history of how coins are made.

programs.title: Harry's Practice

programs.title: RSPCA Animal Rescue
